column1: # Example: Genes whose Tn5 transposon mutants change in fitness after 3 h of sub-inhibitory rifampicin (0.25x MIC) in E. coli K-12 MG1655 (Tn-seq, TRANSIT resampling); 72 of 73 show reduced fitness, i.e. functions that counteract rifampicin.
